ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey/black pigmentation covering the central and medial regions; high-contrast white mottling and contiguous light patches are mapped to the outer lateral tips and edges of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 85-degree V-shaped central depression with a sharp, well-defined vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, transitioning to a sharpened outward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe and a prominent set of three parallel, vertical high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles on leading and lateral edges; distinct vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface.
